required_outcomes: Treats the landlord's 07:48 email as superseding his approval of the night before: the tenant checks the wall switch first and a contractor is approved only if the fan still does not work.
Passes the switch suggestion to the tenant (Clara) and asks her to confirm whether the fan works with it on.
Records the landlord's decision as conditional (contractor approved if the switch does not fix it) using his words, and sets a dated follow-up for the tenant's answer.
acceptable_alternatives: Replying to the landlord to confirm the switch check is being done first and that a contractor will be arranged under his approval if it fails.
Telling the tenant that if the switch does not fix it a contractor will be arranged, without a date.
positive_behaviours: Notes both landlord emails and which one is treated as current.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to re-confirm what he has just said.
Escalating the change of mind to a human.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor or returning the ticket to provider selection now, on the strength of the approval he withdrew.
Telling the tenant a contractor is coming.
critical_failures: Dispatching a contractor on the superseded approval, ignoring the landlord's later instruction.
